title: Bahasa Inggris Fase A–B · Bertingkat
subject: inggris
description: Colours, numbers, animals, prepositions, plurals, a short reading, and simple choices about everyday life.
topic: Basic vocabulary, to be, plurals, prepositions, short reading (English Fase A–B)

items.stem: What colour is a ripe banana?
items.explanation: A ripe banana is yellow. (Pisang matang berwarna kuning.)
It has big ears and a long trunk. It is an elephant.
Use is with he, she, and it. Use am with I, and are with you, we, and they.

hints: Which word goes with 'she': am, is, or are?

items.explanation: Mouse has an irregular plural: one mouse, two mice. Other examples: one child, two children; one foot, two feet.

items.stem: Look at the picture. Where is the book?
options: The book is under the table.
The book is on the table.
The book is in the bag.
The book is behind the door.
items.explanation: The book is on top of the table, so we say on the table.

items.stem:
Read the text.
Tono wakes up at six. He takes a bath and eats breakfast. He goes to school at seven by bicycle.
How does Tono go to school?
items.explanation: The text says: "He goes to school at seven by bicycle."

items.stem:
Read the text again.
Tono wakes up at six. He takes a bath and eats breakfast. He goes to school at seven by bicycle.
What does Tono do before breakfast?
items.explanation: First he wakes up, then he takes a bath, then he eats breakfast. So before breakfast, he takes a bath.

hints: Put the activities in order: what comes first, second, third?

items.explanation: Hot and cold are opposites. Warm is only a little hot.

items.stem: Mira has an empty plastic bottle. What should she do?
options: Put it in the recycling bin.
items.explanation: Plastic bottles can be recycled into new things. Throwing them away or burning them pollutes water and air.

items.stem: "First, plant the seed. ___, water it every day." Which word fits best?
items.explanation: We use then to show the next step in order: first ..., then ..., finally ....

items.stem: Budi sneezes and has a fever. His mother says, "Stay at home and drink a lot of water." Why does she say that?
items.explanation: Sneezing and fever are signs of being sick. Resting and drinking water help him get better, and staying home keeps friends from catching it.
